pythonFunction.name: fetch_technician_slots
pythonFunction.description:
Finds up to three appointment slots from a date onward. Only weekdays within 30 days are
offered; when nothing opens within seven days it says so, and the agent offers an SMS
notification instead of saying there is no availability. Before calling this tool, speak a brief
conversational pacing phrase while it runs.

Args:
    address: Standardized service address (REQUIRED).
    date: Earliest wanted date, YYYY-MM-DD; empty means today.
    type: Appointment type: start, stop, reconnect or meter_test (REQUIRED).
    tenant: Injected by the system from tenant_id; leave empty.

Returns:
    dict with ok, slots (slot, date, window), slot_within_7_days and agent_action.
